title: Ending exaggeration preserves living meaning

captions.energy: Matching words to the actual request
captions.emotions: Feeling warmth in a detailed answer

meaning: You can end an excessive generalisation and name a request more precisely, preserving a warm detailed exchange instead of defence against unnecessary accusations.
text: Death in the physical position of your Vishuddha appears in ending an excessive generalisation. Justice in energy supports a wish to match words to the actual request rather than require answers for more than happened. The Empress in emotions brings warmth and richness to a detailed reply. You can leave a familiar loud formula and make room for specific meaning. Precision need not impoverish conversation; it opens space for an actual story instead of defending an entire personality.

For example, you stop saying “You never tell me anything” when you want more about one meeting. Instead, you name the specific interest and ask about a conversation that stayed in memory. **A precise request leaves room for a living account**. The answer no longer has to disprove complete absence of openness. Details appear and communication feels warmer. Yet the present request does not become a promise to tell everything; you discuss one story and what you genuinely want to share within it.

Dryness returns if ending a generalisation prohibits expressing any strong need. Precision then permits only careful phrases while the real wish remains outside the exchange again. Constructive Justice helps name it proportionately rather than diminish it into insignificance. You can want greater participation and say so directly; warmth comes through hearing a request without unnecessary accusation rather than reducing how much it matters.
